items.name: LineIndex
items.summary: Index for fast [byte offset](TextSize) to [`LineColumn`] conversions.

methods.name: from_source_text
methods.summary: Builds the [`LineIndex`] from the source text of a file.

methods.name: line_column
methods.signature: fn line_column(&self, offset: TextSize, content: &str) -> LineColumn
methods.summary: Returns the line and column number for an UTF-8 byte offset.

methods.name: line_count
methods.summary: Return the number of lines in the source code.

methods.name: line_end
methods.signature: fn line_end(&self, line: OneIndexed, contents: &str) -> TextSize
methods.summary: Returns the [byte offset](TextSize) of the `line`'s end. The offset is the end of the line, up to and including the newline character ending the line (if any).

methods.name: line_index
methods.summary: Returns the row number for a given offset.

methods.name: line_len
methods.signature: fn line_len(&self, line: OneIndexed, text: &str, encoding: PositionEncoding) -> usize
methods.summary: Returns the length of the line in characters, respecting the given encoding

methods.name: line_range
methods.signature: fn line_range(&self, line: OneIndexed, contents: &str) -> TextRange
methods.summary: Returns the [`TextRange`] of the `line` with the given index. The start points to the first character's [byte offset](TextSize), the end up to, and including the newline character ending the line (if any).

methods.name: line_start
methods.signature: fn line_start(&self, line: OneIndexed, contents: &str) -> TextSize
methods.summary: Returns the [byte offset](TextSize) for the `line` with the given index.

methods.name: line_starts
methods.summary: Returns the [byte offsets](TextSize) for every line

methods.name: offset
methods.signature: fn offset(&self, position: SourceLocation, text: &str, position_encoding: PositionEncoding) -> TextSize
methods.summary: Returns the [UTF-8 byte offset](TextSize) at `line` and `character` where character is counted using the given encoding.

methods.name: source_location
methods.signature: fn source_location(&self, offset: TextSize, text: &str, encoding: PositionEncoding) -> SourceLocation
methods.summary: Given a UTF-8 byte offset, returns the line and character offset according to the given encoding.

items.name: OneIndexed
items.summary: Type-safe wrapper for a value whose logical range starts at `1`, for instance the line or column numbers in a file

methods.name: checked_add
methods.summary: Checked addition. Returns `None` if overflow occurred.

methods.name: checked_sub
methods.summary: Checked subtraction. Returns `None` if overflow occurred.

methods.name: digits
methods.summary: Calculate the number of digits in `self`.

methods.name: from_zero_indexed
methods.summary: Construct a new [`OneIndexed`] from a zero-indexed value

methods.name: get
methods.summary: Returns the value as a primitive type.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a non-zero if the given value is not zero.

methods.name: saturating_add
methods.signature: const fn saturating_add(self, rhs: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Saturating integer addition. Computes `self + rhs`, saturating at the numeric bounds instead of overflowing.

methods.name: saturating_sub
methods.signature: const fn saturating_sub(self, rhs: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Saturating integer subtraction. Computes `self - rhs`, saturating at the numeric bounds instead of overflowing.

methods.name: to_zero_indexed
methods.summary: Return the zero-indexed primitive value for this [`OneIndexed`]
